Latin word

cessō

cessō, cessāre, cessāvī, cessātum

verb, first conjugation

idle; be idle, delay, loiter or stop doing something; unsubscribe

In this lexicon

  • idle

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 102: loaf

  • slack off

    the recommended word · classical

  • subscribe

    also used · modern · Traupman 262, 400

Examples

    He idles all day / has been idling all day.composed

  • Nōlī cessāre.

    Don’t dawdle / stop slacking.composed
